title: Bottoms Up!
text:
Bottoms Up!. I just started drinking hot tea again. This has been a cold Winter here in ol' Cleveland... and I found some yummy sounding almond tea blend, loose, and couldn't find my old tea ball anywhere. When I saw these I was enchanted.
They're very small in circumference. A large blended herbal tea that has pieces of fruit and goodies in it is kinda hard to stuff into it, but it can be done! They stay on your cup securely while you sip, too. I like that my tinned ginger doesn't leak out of these nice, tiny holes!
I like 'em!!
